title: Rosemary Beach "The Salty Rose" 49 Hamilton Lane Main House
h1: Rosemary Beach "The Salty Rose" 49 Hamilton Lane Main House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- This home has been designed by and is owned by Kate from Kate Marker Interiors- Located Near Town Center- Private Beach- 4 Neighborhood Pools- Private Pool- Fitness Center and Racquet Club Access- 1 vehicle parking- 2 Adult Bikes- Adjacent to Timpoochee Trail- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: The Salty Rose Main House is a 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom Rosemary Beach home that sleeps 6. Guests will love the private splash pool with a fire feature, outdoor kitchen, posh finishes, and tranquil interiors. The Salty Rose is close to restaurants, shops, community pools, and the beach.An elevated front porch welcomes guests to the home and is a beautiful place to relax and greet neighbors headed to the beach. Stepping inside, guests will find a living, dining, and kitchen area decorated in subdued shades of dusty rose and beige. Hardwood floors, exposed ceiling beams, and natural light add to the inviting atmosphere. A sofa and armchairs surround a gas fireplace and a 50” Smart TV in the living area and are divided from a galley-style kitchen by a round dining table. A bi-fold wall in the kitchen opens completely to a private courtyard, expanding the space and bringing the outdoors in. Guests can prepare meals using a Wolf 6-burner gas range and premium appliances in the kitchen, or fire up the gas grill in the courtyard’s outdoor kitchen. Guests can dine poolside beneath the stars, recline on a lounge chair, and watch the flames dance on the pool’s fire feature.Guests can grab a cocktail on the way up to the second floor, thanks to a wine cooler and beverage station tucked into the stair landing. The second floor includes a guest bedroom with a loft space and a primary bedroom. The spacious guest bedroom uses a shared hall bathroom and features a lovely 4-poster king bed next to a gas fireplace with a 50” Smart TV. Stairs lead to a loft area with 2 twin beds. Guests staying in the primary bedroom will enjoy a unique bathroom with a glass-enclosed shower that has 2 rainfall shower heads and a large skylight. The relaxing all-white bedroom has a king bed and exposed ceiling beams.Guests can explore all that Rosemary Beach has to offer on 2 included adult bikes. With these finishes and amenities, The Salty Rose Main House will book quickly.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 6)SECOND FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: King Bed and 2 Twin Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Your rental property may share a courtyard or lot with a carriage house or main house that is owner-occupied or rented to separate guests from your party.
